firstClientsTips: Start with people who already know and trust you — friends, family, and your existing network — before spending on ads.
Offer a small, low-risk first engagement (a free consultation, trial, or starter package) to remove the barrier to a first "yes".
Ask every first client for a review or referral immediately after a good experience — don't wait weeks.
Show up where your future clients already are (a local Facebook group, an industry forum, a neighborhood app) instead of waiting for them to find you.

launchSteps.description: Talk to 10 potential customers before building anything — confirm they'd actually pay for this.
A simple website, a business email, and a way to accept payment — done in days, not months.
Go direct — outreach, your network, local groups — rather than waiting on inbound traffic.
Once you have a repeatable way to get a client, turn it into a simple, repeatable process.
Put a fixed share of early revenue back into the channel that brought your best clients.

recommendedAutomations: An automatic welcome email/reply the moment a new lead reaches out, so no one waits on you.
A scheduled follow-up reminder task for any lead who hasn't replied in 3 days.
A simple pipeline in the CRM with stages for New → Contacted → Proposal Sent → Won, so nothing falls through the cracks.
